name: nist-csf-chatbot
description: Web chatbot for NIST CSF 2.0 with MCP integration

scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n MCP,WEB -c blue,green "npm run start:mcp" "npm run start:web"
scripts.setup:mcp: cd mcp-server && npm install && npm run build && npm run import:csf-framework && npm run seed:questions
